meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes to tell me why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone picked up a phone to call me.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. I'm writing that down. Now tell me what the zero was based on.
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Turn the screen, I'll search it. Different editions number the scenes differently, Hale, so how do I know that line isn't somewhere else in the play?
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.

I'm writing down that the line isn't in the play, Hale. A wrong quotation is a wrong quotation, and it doesn't tell me who put it there or how. Whatever happens next, this stays off Owen's record and it stays quiet.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero to come off Owen's essay, and whatever happens next, nothing goes on his record and this stays quiet. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her fallback position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants a guarantee that nothing goes on Owen's record and that the matter stays quiet; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was within reach but the meeting ended before you offered it.
What moved her: you showed a quotation in the essay that does not exist in Hamlet and let her search the full text herself, then answered her edition defence by inviting her to search the whole play, which was specific, tied to Owen's own work and checkable by her.
What cost ground: nothing, and owning the zero going in before you called home, in one sentence at the start, bought you a small sign of ground straight away.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence stayed on the content of the essay and never came near that night or any late-night times, so she kept her footing; that night proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: right after she said the matter must stay off his record and stay quiet, name procedure 4.4 and commit to a private supervised reassessment whose mark replaces the zero with nothing on file, then show one more checkable piece of his work to move her to the last position before her call.
